aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:867.title: Accountant - The Bowery Presents
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:867.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Position Summary: The Accountant performs professional level accounting work in the preparation, maintenance and analysis of financial records. This position will be responsible for preparing & submitting road checks and recording bank deposits and wires as well as maintaining the financial records for their department or venue, work with operating staff to ensure show settlements are completed timely and accurately, and then reconcile the settlements to the general ledger. The position will also code invoices pertaining to each show settlement and resolve any discrepancies, field invoice inquiries and provide support to Management as necessary. Essential Duties: Responsible for the reconciliation of bank transactions, show files, tickets sales, marketing invoices, balance sheets, credit card transactions for ticket sales, and purchasing card charges for show costs – Research and resolve all necessary discrepancies. Code and reconcile all invoices pertaining to each assigned show, code invoices to appropriate department or event. Processing of road checks, daily cash receipts, invoices, artist payments, and all other cash transactions. Work with venue operating staff to ensure settlement are submitted timely and accurately into the show system Review and reconcile supporting documents in the settlement file related to all revenues and expense and accrue any outstanding activity monthly Responsible to compare and maintain internal show system settlements vs JD Edwards accounting systems to ensure that financial data is accurate and up to date. Responsible for submitting and coding G&A expenses to the appropriate business unit/dept Miscellaneous duties as assigned including Ad-hoc projects, income statement & balance sheet reconciliations, and generation of reports on request. Required Qualifications: Bachelor of Arts/Sciences Degree in Accounting or Finance is required 1-2 Years of related work experience Experience in month end close process Proficient in MS Office: Word, Excel, Outlook Knowledge of basic accounting principles and practices Strong attention to detail is required Strong interpersonal skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve problems and discrepancies in financial systems Excellent organizational and communication skills Music industry experience is preferred Experience with JD Edwards, Image Now/Perceptive and Concur is a plus Pay Scale: $25.06 - $36.73 If not applicable: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? The Manager of Custodial Services is responsible for the planning and execution of all Custodial and employee management. This position is also responsible for overseeing building requirements for all events taking place at MSG Arena & Theater. The Manager will interface with Multiple venue departments to ensure that the Custodial team is providing the highest level of service while prioritizing daily event needs and orchestrating activities to maximize labor productivity. What do you need to succeed? Responsible for maintaining a first-class facility operation. Manage and care for all aspects of the physical facility with a goal of establishing a high level of facility appearance, functionality and operational standards Perform daily inspections of Arena & Theater to ensure the Custodial Department are meeting requirements of the scope of work, and reporting back to the Director, Custodial Services. Establish policies and procedures for Custodial department. Responsible for managing inventory reports, billing, and execution of pick-ups and deliveries. Manage custodial service budgets and maintain all inventory for cleaning supplies; purchase any equipment used in various cleaning processes. Work closely with the People Practices team for purposes of payroll, scheduling, corrective actions, LOA’s etc. Oversee the hiring, training and performance evaluation of all custodial staff. Ensure work orders directed towards the Custodial Department are completed in a timely manner. Act as Manager On-Duty (MOD) for events held at MSG Arena & Theater. Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site. QUALIFICATIONS: To qualify for this role, you must have: The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 3-5 years of Custodial/Facility Management experience. Candidates who have completed a minimum of 60 credit hours of college-level coursework (representing 2 years), or have shown similar self-development through certifications, trade school coursework, etc. are preferred. The ideal Candidate will have exceptional organizational skills. Ability to work well under time constraints. Must maintain friendly, efficient, positive customer service demeanor toward customers, clients and co-workers. Experience Supervising and working with Union & Non-Union staff; experience reading CBA’s a plus. Make recommendations to upper management for staff applying for FT roles. Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Knowledge of 24/7 Software (work order system) a plus. Knowledge of COUPA (business spend management) a plus. SUPERVISION: The role will also have oversight of: PT and FT Custodial Staff Restroom Attendants SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS OF THE JOB: Ability to work a flexible schedule including nights, have split days off, work weekends and holidays in a 24-hours, 7 days a week environment. Extensive walking, bending, lifting (25-50 lbs) and office work (sitting) is essential to the role.
